name: Dirge Singer
body:
Prerequisite(s): Bardic performance class feature, Knowledge (religion) 5 ranks

Benefit(s): Through your studies of religious scripture you have learned to intone religious chants and prayers into your performances, allowing them to affect creatures of the undead type with mind-affecting bardic performances and inspirations. However, doing so requires you to expend 1 additional round of bardic performance each round you start and maintain a performance augmented by dirge singer.

Normal: Undead creatures are immune to your mind-affecting bardic performances and inspirations.
